craft_notes: Sthāyin: dismissal — offering dissolving. Rows: offering catalogue; water-close. Rejected: Tarpana glosses — killed: plain acts. Read aloud: softening tread.

lines: Bring smoke and wine and blossoms to self-surrender's feet;
murmur in your own stillness, gather home, and give to the waters.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato gandhadhūpāsavakusumādīn ātmaprahvībhāvāntān arpayitvā svaviśrāntyā japtvā upasaṃhṛtya jale nikṣipet
